name: color-filters
title: Color Filters
description: Toggle macOS Color Filters and switch between filter types (Grayscale, Protanopia, Deuteranopia, Tritanopia, Color Tint)
author: RemarkRemedy

commands.name: set-protanopia
commands.title: Set Protanopia Filter (Red/Green)
commands.description: Enable red/green color filter for protanopia

commands.name: set-deuteranopia
commands.title: Set Deuteranopia Filter (Green/Red)
commands.description: Enable green/red color filter for deuteranopia

commands.name: set-tritanopia
commands.title: Set Tritanopia Filter (Blue/Yellow)
commands.description: Enable blue/yellow color filter for tritanopia

commands.name: select-color-filter
commands.title: Select Color Filter
commands.description: Choose a color filter from a list

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
